# Ix0 Type Definition Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Define `Ix0` and correct the fixed-dimension family scaffolding in `src/dimension/static.rs` so `Ix0` is zero-sized and `Ix1`-`Ix6` already have the exact `#[repr(C)]` tuple-struct layouts required by the design.

**Architecture:** `src/dimension/static.rs` accumulates the fixed-rank family `Ix0` through `Ix6`. `Ix0` is the only zero-sized member. `Ix1`-`Ix6` are `#[repr(C)]` tuple structs over `usize` fields so later `Dimension::slice()` pointer casts are valid.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, std

**Design Docs:** `design/02-dimension.md` §5.2 (static dimension definitions), `design/02-dimension.md` §5.2 "Ix0 special semantics", `design/02-dimension.md` §11 Decision 1 (static rank ceiling)

**Prerequisites:** W2T1 must be complete.

---

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{Ix0, Ix1, Ix2, Ix3, Ix4, Ix5, Ix6};
    use core::mem::{align_of, size_of};

        assert_eq!(size_of::<Ix5>(), size_of::<[usize; 5]>());
        assert_eq!(align_of::<Ix5>(), align_of::<usize>());

    #[test]

### Task 2: Implement the exact fixed-dimension type definitions

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/dimension/static.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the complete `static.rs` implementation**

Replace `src/dimension/static.rs` with the following content:

```rust
/// Zero-dimensional (scalar) dimension. ZST.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix0;

/// One-dimensional dimension.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix1(pub usize);

/// Two-dimensional dimension.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix2(pub usize, pub usize);

/// Three-dimensional dimension.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix3(pub usize, pub usize, pub usize);

/// Four-dimensional dimension.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix4(pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize);

/// Five-dimensional dimension.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix5(pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize);

/// Six-dimensional dimension.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix6(pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize);

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{Ix0, Ix1, Ix2, Ix3, Ix4, Ix5, Ix6};
    use core::mem::{align_of, size_of};

    #[test]
    fn test_ix0_is_zero_sized() {
        assert_eq!(size_of::<Ix0>(), 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ix1_layout_matches_one_usize() {
        let dim = Ix1(7);
        assert_eq!(dim.0, 7);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<Ix1>(), size_of::<[usize; 1]>());
        assert_eq!(align_of::<Ix1>(), align_of::<usize>());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ix2_layout_matches_two_usizes() {
        let dim = Ix2(2, 3);
        assert_eq!((dim.0, dim.1), (2, 3));
        assert_eq!(size_of::<Ix2>(), size_of::<[usize; 2]>());
        assert_eq!(align_of::<Ix2>(), align_of::<usize>());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ix3_layout_matches_three_usizes() {
        let dim = Ix3(2, 3, 4);
        assert_eq!((dim.0, dim.1, dim.2), (2, 3, 4));
        assert_eq!(size_of::<Ix3>(), size_of::<[usize; 3]>());
        assert_eq!(align_of::<Ix3>(), align_of::<usize>());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ix4_layout_matches_four_usizes() {
        let dim = Ix4(1, 2, 3, 4);
        assert_eq!((dim.0, dim.1, dim.2, dim.3), (1, 2, 3, 4));
        assert_eq!(size_of::<Ix4>(), size_of::<[usize; 4]>());
        assert_eq!(align_of::<Ix4>(), align_of::<usize>());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ix5_layout_matches_five_usizes() {
        let dim = Ix5(1, 2, 3, 4, 5);
        assert_eq!((dim.0, dim.1, dim.2, dim.3, dim.4), (1, 2, 3, 4, 5));
        assert_eq!(size_of::<Ix5>(), size_of::<[usize; 5]>());
        assert_eq!(align_of::<Ix5>(), align_of::<usize>());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ix6_layout_matches_six_usizes() {
        let dim = Ix6(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6);
        assert_eq!((dim.0, dim.1, dim.2, dim.3, dim.4, dim.5), (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6));
        assert_eq!(size_of::<Ix6>(), size_of::<[usize; 6]>());
        assert_eq!(align_of::<Ix6>(), align_of::<usize>());
    }
}
```
